messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH - inference-queue backlog (prod-eu-west) — page fired to eng-oncall. Alert details: queue_depth=18k, oldest_msg=00:12:34, autoscaler_recommendation=+50 nodes, autoscaler_status=lagging, error_rate=5xx↑. https://alerts.redwood.example/alert/1769997777 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page  PD-90817 triggered for service 'inference-queue-prod-eu'. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre -> infra-sre. Please ack to stop repeats.
sam: ACKED. I'm on it. Taking primary.
maria-ops: oncall (eu) here, +1. Noting customer-facing errors reported from Monitoring (EU tenants). Any quick mitigation?
henry-sre: noticed autoscaler controllers spiking retries. I just checked the scale-controller logs — looks like GC quota errors from cloud provider when provisioning new nodes. Past 2m: "QuotaExceeded: Insufficient instance quota for region eu-west-3". Pasting tail: ```
E0421 12:29:37.123 scale-controller.go:482] failed to create instance: QuotaExceeded: Insufficient quota
  status code: 403, request id: f8c3-...```
leah-eng: if autoscaler can't provision, we need a fallback: 1) manual scale up of warm pool or 2) route high-priority tenants to fallback region. Sam, which is faster?
sam: manual scale is fastest. I'm going to bump inference-worker to 30 replicas to drain queue while infra sorts quotas. Command: ```kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=30``` I'll run as soon as Maria confirms no scheduled deploys.
maria-ops: no deploys in next 15m. Go ahead. Also opening a cloud quota request now (submitted ticket CLQ-4529).
henry-sre: FYI manual scale will help but KV cache cold-start might increase token latency. Recommend also enabling quick prefix-caching for high-traffic prefixes: toggle flag in rollout service: ```curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/featureflags/cache-warmup -d '{"enabled":true}'```
sam: scaled to 30. Pods coming up. kubectl get pods shows 18/30 pending due to imagePullThrottle? Hmm seeing a bunch of CrashLoopBackOff on new pods: ```Back-off pulling image "registry.redwood/internal/inference:prod-2026-04"```
leah-eng: ugh image pull error -> registry throttling. That will slow manual scale. Can we switch to the fallback image hosted on our mirror? Command: ```kubectl set image deployment/inference-worker inference-worker=mirror.registry.redwood/inference:prod-2026-04 -n prod```
sam: switching to mirror now. Applied. Pods are transitioning to Running. Great, more replicas Ready. Queue drain rate improving.
maria-ops: monitoring dashboard: queue depth dropping from 18k -> 9.2k in 5m, error rate falling from 5xx 4.8% -> 1.7%. P99 tail latency for EU customers still high (~1200ms) but improving. Documenting customer impact: "Elevated 5xx and latency for EU region for ~18 minutes; affecting ~2.3% of paid tenants (rate-limited requests failing)."
henry-sre: autoscaler fix path: cloud quota team responded — we have a 30-minute ETA for quota bump OR we can failover some provisioning to another region. I'll coordinate with infra. Creating INC-12345 and linking cloud ticket CLQ-4529.
sam: handing off to henry for follow-up/RCAs once this stabilizes. I'll stay for 10m to watch queue drain then hand to next oncall. @pagerduty please update status to acknowledged -> in_progress.
pagerduty: Updated PD incident PD-90817 state: acknowledged -> in_progress. Notification suppressed for 10m.
maria-ops: leaving note for postmortem: timeline, root cause = provisioning quota + registry pull throttling combo, mitigations = manual scale + mirror image + quota request, customer impact summarized above. Assigning postmortem to henry-sre and sam.
henry-sre: acknowledged. I'll do a follow-up runbook: 1) add region fallback into autoscaler policy, 2) add registry mirror autopromote, 3) emergency warm pool preflight for EU. Tagging leah-eng for infra changes.
leah-eng: noted. I'll start an infra PR for fallback policies and warm pool pre-provisioning knobs.
sam: queue < 1k now, error rate back down to baseline. I'm dropping out, handing to henry for closure. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
henry-sre: taking post-incident ownership. Closing thread once quota bump confirmed and postmortem created (INC-12345).
